Different LTM/LPS and lunar geographic coordinate systems serve different grid products. A shapefile must be read with its actual projection/datum and correct longitude conventions before overlay or measurement.
The grid precision labels (1 km, 100 m, 10 m) describe navigation grid spacing, not terrain measurement accuracy, hazard detection, DTM resolution, or positional uncertainty of a landing system.

historical_leads.title: Test Connecting Ridge / Site 01 as a historical comparator

The page also reports longer continuous illumination periods at 5 m above the surface for Site 1.
historical_leads.next_action: Keep as a named historical comparator and retrieve the Site01 ROI shapefile and uncertainty-clone products before any same-method reanalysis.
interpretation_limits: This is a historical illumination comparison, not an evaluation for a future crewed mission window.
The result covers illumination only; it does not establish touchdown roughness, safe approach corridors, surface operations, communications link margin, thermal survival or resource access.
Site01 / ROI4–6 are legacy research identifiers. Spatial boundaries and compatibility with any modern agency candidate region must be explicitly validated.
The original page result has not been independently recomputed in this repository. Preserve it as a source-reported finding, not a new measurement.
